mihoyoStock.title: Mihoyo Shop Stock Monitor
mihoyoStock.desc: Track mihoyo shop stock and get a QQ reminder when items are back in stock
mihoyoStock.needLoginDesc: Sign in to use the mihoyo shop stock monitor
mihoyoStock.addDesc: Paste a mihoyo shop link or a 19-digit goods ID
mihoyoStock.addSuccess: Added. You'll get a QQ reminder when it's back in stock
mihoyoStock.emptyDesc: Add mihoyo shop items you want to track. You'll get a QQ reminder when they're back in stock
mihoyoStock.note: Stock is checked in the cloud about every 10 minutes. A QQ reminder is sent through the bound QQ bot once an item is back in stock. You need to bind QQ to receive pushes.
